decisive_finding.cause: Lifecycle apply calls adapter.restore after every effect failure. RepeatUse and IdempotentReinstall plans contain only verification and runtime-probe effects, set writes_host_state false, and may be authorized with allow_host_write false; their failure path can nevertheless cross into the adapter restore write.

false_pass_control.missing_behavior: Existing zero-write controls construct read-only plans but never apply a failing verification or probe through an adapter that records restore calls.

corrective_action: On a read-only plan effect failure, close the one-shot apply authority and return a stable causal read failure without calling restore, observing mutable recovery state, arming recovery, or changing host state. Add failing VerifyInstalledBytes and ProbeRuntime adapter-call controls for both read-only intents, plus replay, concurrency, serialization, and recursive zero-write checks.
claim_ceiling: The plugin lifecycle source candidate remains under REWORK. Root module/distribution wiring and all package, marketplace, install, cache, app-registry, Plugins UI, discovery, runtime, journey, readiness, release, and completion claims remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim readiness, release, or completion.
